title: More than we expected!
text:
My daughter gave my “boy” a Bark Box and we were truly impressed with the contents.
These toys weren’t something that you see in the stores, they were extremely durable for my professional chewer. They were unusual and the dog loved them all. Two of the toys that were included had additional surprises for us. Once he had finally got a spot chewed and you could see under it, there was another toy underneath it. When he got through chewing and pulling that second layer off (about 2 weeks later) of the toy, he got to something plastic inside. Again we were so surprised to see a tough rubber ball inside of these other layers. It has little nubs on the outside and a squeaky on the inside. Now that’s what I call a gift that kept giving. Also, it’s a dog that keeps on playing with delight!
We were all really impressed with the box we received.
label: positive
